sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (46 marks)
items: 1. Name the four cardinal points of a compass. (4 marks)
2. Name any three physical features found in Kenya. (3 marks)
3. State two ways people protect the environment. (2 marks)
4. Name the eight neighbouring countries of Kenya. (8 marks)
5. What is the difference between weather and climate? (2 marks)
